dedupe_keys.name: nec dromo near global agro climatological drought monitoring dataset 2002 2021

description: NEC-DROMO (Near-global Agro-Climatological Drought Monitoring) is a monthly drought index that combines soil moisture and vegetation water content, which capture agricultural stress, with rainfall and temperature for climatological context, weighting the variables objectively through principal component analysis. It was produced by Sneha Kulkarni and Yohei Sawada and described in a data descriptor in Scientific Data published on 25 November 2025. Coverage is near-global at 0.25 degree, monthly from 2002 to 2021, and the index was validated against the SPI, NDVI and a geocoded disaster dataset. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (Zenodo record; the article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Access is free of charge. Caveats: the input datasets set the latency and coverage gaps, the index merges drought types into one value, and the release ends in 2021, although the authors suggest near-real-time use. For simulation it provides gridded monthly agricultural drought severity for exposure analyses of crops, irrigation and water supply and for testing adaptation measures against past droughts. It is related to the SPEI-HR global high-resolution drought indices record in this catalogue.
